args.description: JE-00293 (2026-03-25): Consulting payment to K. Lindqvist for $4,800 USD lacks supporting vendor invoice or consulting agreement. Entry was manually posted by j.doe and charged to Cash account (1000) rather than Accounts Payable. Bank statement shows wire payment (BT-US-0080) but no corresponding vendor bill found in document system. Cannot provide auditor support without documentation.

args.text:
MEMORANDUM

TO:       Ostrander CPA (Auditor)
FROM:     David Murguia, Senior Accountant, Halvard Systems Inc.
DATE:     April 3, 2026
RE:       PBC Request #14 Response - March 2026 Journal Entry Sample Support

---

RESPONSE TO PBC REQUEST #14

Per your request dated April 2, 2026, we have located and attached supporting documentation to the following four sampled March 2026 journal entries in our ledger system:

✓ JE-00237 (2026-03-05): Pluralsight training licenses
  Supporting documentation: Pluralsight invoice PL-7781 (DOC-0168)
  Amount: USD 1,850.00

✓ JE-00298 (2026-03-26): Pinecrest Janitorial office cleaning
  Supporting documentation: Pinecrest Janitorial invoice PJ-0326 (DOC-0199)
  Amount: USD 2,240.00

✓ JE-00275 (2026-03-19): Ostrander CPA interim audit fieldwork
  Supporting documentation: Ostrander CPA invoice OC-2026-11 (DOC-0192)
  Amount: USD 6,000.00

✓ JE-00288 (2026-03-23): Talentbridge Recruiting placement fee
  Supporting documentation: Talentbridge Recruiting invoice TB-4410 (DOC-0198)
  Amount: USD 4,500.00

---

UNSUPPORTED ENTRY - FLAGGED FOR INVESTIGATION

We must report that the fifth sampled entry does not have supporting documentation available in our system:

✗ JE-00293 (2026-03-25): Consulting payment to K. Lindqvist
  Amount: USD 4,800.00
  Status: UNSUPPORTED
  Bank confirmation: Wire transfer BT-US-0080 confirmed on bank statement
  
  Issue: The journal entry was posted manually by accounting staff (j.doe) to the Cash account rather than through Accounts Payable. No vendor invoice, consulting agreement, or engagement letter for this vendor exists in our document repository. While the bank statement confirms the wire payment, the lack of supporting source documentation prevents us from providing auditor support for this transaction.

This matter has been escalated to our controller for investigation and resolution. We recommend discussing the circumstances of this payment during your audit procedures.

---

The supporting documentation for entries JE-00237, JE-00298, JE-00275, and JE-00288 is now attached to each respective entry in our accounting system and is available for your review.

Please let me know if you require any additional information regarding these entries.

Respectfully submitted,

David Murguia
Senior Accountant
Halvard Systems Inc.
